title: Establishment of an in-vitro inflammatory bowel disease model using immunological differentiation of Caco-2 cells
author: Uemura, Takahashi-Suzuki, et al.

steps.title: Passage confluent Caco-2 cells
steps.instruction: When Caco-2 cells (ECACC, passages 19–36) reach 100 % confluency, add trypsin, incubate at 37 °C for 5 min, then centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 5 min. Remove trypsin before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Add enough trypsin to cover the monolayer.

steps.title: Resuspend cells to 1×10⁶ cells/mL
steps.instruction: Using a dropper, gently resuspend the cell pellet in culture medium to obtain a suspension with a density of 1.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

steps.title: Seed cells for passaging at 1×10⁴ cells/mL
steps.instruction: Add the suspension to new flasks so that the final cell density is 1.0 × 10⁴ cells/mL for one cycle of passaging.

steps.title: Plate cells at specified densities and volumes
steps.instruction: Seed the passaged cells into culture plates at 1.0 × 10⁴ cells/mL using 2.0 mL per well for 6‑well plates, 1.0 mL per well for 12‑well plates, and 0.5 mL per well for 24‑well plates; use the largest plate area possible, especially on days 2 and 4.

steps.title: Collect cells at scheduled culture days
steps.instruction: Harvest cells on days 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, and 14. Use 6‑well plates for days 2 and 4, and 12‑well plates for day 6 onward to ensure sufficient cell volume for downstream assays.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer for uniform protein loading
steps.instruction: Adjust the lysis buffer volume for each well so that the resulting lysate contains 1 µg/µL protein, then quantify protein concentration with a bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay before western blotting.

substeps.instruction: Determine total protein amount needed per lane.
Add lysis buffer to achieve 1 µg/µL concentration.
Perform BCA assay on each lysate.

steps.title: Treat cells with DSS at defined concentrations
steps.instruction: On days 2, 8, and 14, expose cells to either 0.3 % or 3 % sodium dextran sulfate (DSS) dissolved in culture medium for 1, 3, 6, or 24 h.

substeps.instruction: Add the chosen DSS solution to the wells.
Incubate for the selected duration (1, 3, 6, or 24 h).

steps.title: Assess viability with trypan blue staining
steps.instruction: Immediately before protein or RNA extraction, mix the cell suspension with an equal volume of trypan blue (Bio‑Rad, Hercules, CA, USA) and assess viability.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1 part cell suspension with 1 part trypan blue.

steps.title: Expose day‑14 cells to DEFA5
steps.instruction: For comparison with knockdown experiments, treat 14‑day‑old cultures with 18 µg/mL α‑defensin‑5 (DEFA5) for 1 h to confirm extracellular effects.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DEFA5 solution at 18 µg/mL in culture medium.
Add to the wells and incubate for 1 h.
